## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/desktop.py`

**Purpose:** Owns the native pywebview window, ephemeral loopback server lifecycle, and console-optional packaged-binary smoke mode.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep direct JS bridging, downloads, file URLs, remote debugging, fixed ports, remote binds, and every mutation beyond guarded intake disabled.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `cc28b128e76cea696727d2a98e185fa0056f66f1dd1ceaa5bd0d0e46a176652d` changes intentionally.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/app_state.py`

**Purpose:** Composes workspace, planning, tools, contained preflight/artifact reads, lifecycle previews, experience, and blocked state.

**Maintenance rule:** Delegate focused behavior, keep evidence/lifecycle reads read-only, and limit mutations to guarded intake, preferences, and one STL preflight.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/authorized_intake.py`

**Purpose:** Authorizes one selected local file and streams its exact bytes into private app-owned quarantine storage.

**Maintenance rule:** Preserve same-origin token checks, one-time expiry, allowlists, exact lengths, hashing, atomic replacement, rollback, and path privacy.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/contained_execution.py`

**Purpose:** Owns one-slot STL preflight, cancellation, fixed report/proof generation, validation, and bounded JSON reads.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep scope to one app-owned STL check and never add arbitrary paths, commands, processes, tools, toolpaths, or host output opening.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `933bb373426729c1be2ddc27450393e603debf424fbf33e763f4241076e3ecd0` changes intentionally.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/local_request_guard.py`

**Purpose:** Enforces one process token and exact loopback same-origin evidence for every bounded local mutation.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep the token memory-only and reject cross-site, remote, mismatched-host, credential-bearing, and non-HTTP origins.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `95e3112a63988513f06e7e521fd7225b49ef31fe309490dd3cc50fde60964076` changes intentionally.

<a id="source-041"></a>
## `config/execution_request_policy.json`

## `config/output_policy.json`

**Purpose:** Defines per-route output bundles, planned artifacts, proof requirements, logical storage, and false action state.

**Maintenance rule:** Cover every route exactly once and keep creation, opening, proof capture, execution, and launch false.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `2aee81c4642070ceaf24caa37321635d85e977c7dab1510e1385f446927f00fb` changes intentionally.

## `frontend/src/App.test.tsx`

**Purpose:** Exercises twenty-two accepted React workflows including artifact display, execution history, cancellation, and portable safety boundaries.

**Maintenance rule:** Preserve meaningful interaction coverage and require visible false-signal boundaries for cancellation.

## `frontend/src/App.tsx`

**Purpose:** Renders the promoted workbench, execution history/cancel, verified artifact dialog, workflows, proof, and settings.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep history path-redacted, cancellation cooperative, artifact viewing in-app, geometry responsive, and host effects blocked.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `24f76a3d2be03b1bb7cfee8a0c901c6a54cd20efb952ba085f65f8467cb29c4b` changes intentionally.

## `frontend/src/api.test.ts`

**Purpose:** Proves previews, history mapping, early run identity, guarded cancellation, selected artifact reads, and path privacy.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep fetch isolated and reject invalid ids, terminal cancellation, broad actions, paths, and unverified content.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `dfaecbded1529954a4edb0ae2d435a57f2186085dd873ace4059b03ca8b37650` changes intentionally.

## `frontend/src/api.ts`

**Purpose:** Adapts path-redacted history/state, performs guarded intake/preflight/cancel, and fetches selected verified report/proof JSON.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep cancellation token-bound and bodyless; block arbitrary routes, signals, tools, host opens, folders, archives, and paths.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `315f62678f8d739f5bd6332a909903f380635ec59faec724beb1d684af610185` changes intentionally.

## `frontend/src/test/setup.ts`

**Purpose:** Installs DOM-aware assertion matchers for isolated React component and workflow tests.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep test-only and do not import this setup into the production bundle.

## `frontend/tsconfig.json`

**Purpose:** Configures strict browser TypeScript compilation for the promoted React source tree.

**Maintenance rule:** Retain strict checking, no emitted compiler output, and bundler-compatible module resolution.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `a590c6d45eb6afa9fc72c39ad1553478382b809071ab7b88061b021063a6c2c5` changes intentionally.

<!-- source:frontend/tsconfig.json sha256:a590c6d45eb6afa9fc72c39ad1553478382b809071ab7b88061b021063a6c2c5 lines:21 -->

| Line | Source | Explanation |
| ---: | --- | --- |
| 1 | <code>{</code> | Opens or closes a JSON object/array; nesting groups related contract fields and performs no action by itself. |
| 2 | <code>  "compilerOptions": {</code> | Defines JSON field ``compilerOptions``; its value is constrained by the matching schema/service validation where applicable. |
| 3 | <code>    "target": "ES2022",</code> | Defines JSON field ``target``; its value is constrained by the matching schema/service validation where applicable. |
| 4 | <code>    "useDefineForClassFields": true,</code> | Defines JSON field ``useDefineForClassFields``; its value is constrained by the matching schema/service validation where applicable. |
| 5 | <code>    "lib": ["DOM", "DOM.Iterable", "ES2022"],</code> | Defines JSON field ``lib``; its value is constrained by the matching schema/service validation where applicable. |
| 6 | <code>    "allowJs": false,</code> | Defines JSON field ``allowJs``; its value is constrained by the matching schema/service validation where applicable. |
| 7 | <code>    "skipLibCheck": true,</code> | Defines JSON field ``skipLibCheck``; its value is constrained by the matching schema/service validation where applicable. |

## `schemas/intake-authorization.schema.json`

**Purpose:** Defines one short-lived one-time authorization for an exact selected-file name, kind, suffix, size, and timestamp.

**Maintenance rule:** Never add a source path or process token; keep consent bounded to one exact transfer.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `75a6e28ea1d359117a2acf2cb86605c9a746393f9df745efd7fd8ba7018397fb` changes intentionally.

**Purpose:** Defines path-redacted prepared job intent, unaccepted authorization, empty process lifecycle, and logical directories.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep private paths, executable requests, commands, process ids, outputs, audit events, and proof outside the record.

## `schemas/learning-coverage.schema.json`

## `schemas/tool-dry-run.schema.json`

**Purpose:** Defines semantic dry-run summaries, logical references, tool selections, null commands, readiness, and blocked execution.

**Maintenance rule:** Require path-free non-runnable plans and keep command strings, resolved executable paths, handoff, and execution absent.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `9addae8a480a36e3a6c3916b8c33ee7e19e86e6af2fc3849513898b2317559eb` changes intentionally.

## `scripts/build_previous_app_learning_guide.py`

**Purpose:** Generates local exact line coverage for narrowly selected first-party previous-app source while excluding dependencies and outputs.

**Maintenance rule:** Never edit legacy source or traverse .venv, node_modules, dist, logs, ingress, Projects, caches, or generated outputs.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `f0536413018b71ab15a6d834db570b9b5dd937d866cbc59cc9d079f368460c6e` changes intentionally.

## `state/current_status.json`

**Purpose:** Stores authoritative machine-readable current pass, percentages, proof, blocked work, and next pass.

**Maintenance rule:** Update in every completed pass and never claim untested platform, packaging, or action behavior.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `5d6788ada1fd08fbcebda81a62bffc4802770e49890da81b6eb45016938441c9` changes intentionally.

## `state/pass_ledger.json`

**Purpose:** Stores the ordered bounded-pass history with report links and concise proof summaries.

**Maintenance rule:** Append one entry per completed pass; do not rewrite history to hide earlier boundaries.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `b0cca26fd1e703b61a27b1c386805bfa2b66b7b65154e705a3c9e39ca029b493` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_desktop.py`

**Purpose:** Proves secure native-window options, ephemeral server ownership, cleanup, smoke mode, and CLI dispatch without a GUI.

**Maintenance rule:** Inject fake pywebview behavior and never open a real window, external browser, tool, file dialog, or process in tests.

## `tests/test_execution_request.py`

**Purpose:** Proves logical request previews, explicit unaccepted consent, empty audit records, fail-closed joins, and false effects.

**Maintenance rule:** Add negative cases whenever request scope, audit lifecycle, intent fields, or safety boundaries change.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `d3055c4f22e4b52fea302617a8474c36107cfa1e0b1d1c7cadcff3e18b3cdc75` changes intentionally.

**Purpose:** Proves workbench zones, intake, execution history/cancel, capabilities, lifecycle previews, responsive layout, and blocked operations.

**Maintenance rule:** Require generated-id token-guarded cooperative cancel, false signal/path state, lifecycle GET-only behavior, and closed mutation scope.

**Purpose:** Proves legacy metadata compatibility plus strict authorized-record validation, source privacy, and archive non-extraction.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep roots isolated and assert logical locations, privacy fields, and false downstream effects whenever intake evolves.

## `tests/test_intake_preview.py`

**Purpose:** Proves preview policy, record/content revalidation, tamper rejection, raster signatures, and loopback binary transport.

**Maintenance rule:** Use isolated app-owned fixtures and retain no-cache, no-sniff, same-origin, and path-free rejection assertions.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `317807cc7980dad75833a7db04fd7236335563ba54b0f710dc8956273ab02d50` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_learning_guide.py`

**Purpose:** Proves generated guide bytes, selected file coverage, hashes, line totals, and representative explanation quality.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep deterministic and require regeneration whenever implementation or structured-contract source changes.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `922a4887fd468dc7a662e0bd1293dff65d44abcf103a13e285ae8ab65bc0ada1` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_lifecycle_dry_run.py`

**Purpose:** Proves five lifecycle plans, bounded private inventory, deterministic no-write behavior, fail-closed policy, and scan limits.

**Maintenance rule:** Use isolated app data and assert no content/name/path leak, archive, network, installer, mutation, process, or deletion effect appears.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `df0633a2344683128a6f6f0242f8b5a595980c2188a3aac9c5cd932ce454dad7` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_output_proof.py`

**Purpose:** Proves non-writing bundles, logical paths, incomplete proof, policy safety, and complete route coverage.

**Maintenance rule:** Assert every artifact is nonexistent, every proof item incomplete, and no output directory is created.

## `tests/test_runtime_resources.py`

**Purpose:** Proves source and PyInstaller resource roots resolve portably and fail closed when frontend assets are incomplete.

**Maintenance rule:** Exercise source and frozen markers without depending on one checkout location or creating real package outputs.

## `tests/test_server.py`

**Purpose:** Proves loopback serving, security headers, complete authorized intake transfer, blocked mutation, and deterministic shutdown.

**Maintenance rule:** Use temporary roots and ephemeral ports; reject remote binds, CORS preflight, wrong media, and incomplete transfers.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `f7c22c6b63da555f224b187cb725e4a35bb621c19dae7b22ecf8b217d0246ba2` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_tool_dry_run.py`

**Purpose:** Proves deterministic tool selection, logical references, unsupported-family honesty, policy safety, and non-execution.

**Maintenance rule:** Use isolated route/output/tool snapshots and assert no command, resolved path, handoff, process, launch, or write escapes.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `0add44603a62ff8d765d90ffbcb866b2e9ca1ec4112862ba1f8e60fc5ca72f67` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_verify_project.py`

## `tests/test_windows_packaging.py`

**Purpose:** Proves the Windows one-file plan is pinned, portable, non-publishing, and fail-closed on missing source.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep tests read-only and never install dependencies, invoke PyInstaller, sign, launch, or publish an artifact.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `ff2b857d053b7ba84dd67d6af0cbc2ea9ce619d2dc5e8e2a13750c17c590979a` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_workspace_config.py`
